title: Patch: the card crafter shows its preset suggestions again
thread:
**Issue #4294 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #4294: Patch: the card crafter shows its preset suggestions again Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ### What happens When a card has you build a custom card in the craft editor, the editor no longer shows the prefab suggestions (the seeded presets) that used to let you start from a ready-made card. The cards that open the editor (`choose_craft`): - Meditative #17 **True Craft a Card** (`crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c017_true_craft_a_card.rs`): no mode - Meditative+ #16 **Jazakus** (`c016_jazakus.rs`): `potion` mode - Meditative+ #16.1 **Jazakus Prime** (`c016_1_jazakus_prime.rs`): `hugePotion` mode - Meditative+ #26 **Scratch Pad** (`c026_scratch_pad.rs`): `scratch` mode. This one is **meant** to show no suggestions (R1182002), so leave it as it is. (Core #99 Craft a Card is Discover + Fuse and never opens the editor, so this issue doesn't cover it.) ### What should happen R880 and R881 (`spec/rulings/R0880.md`, `R0881.md`): a `craft` prompt offers four seeded presets (Unit, Spell, Field Spell, Trap, or up to `CRAFT_PRESETS` Potions in the potion modes, R1182000/R1182001/R1563008). These are built from the prompt's offer (R1563007), and every mode except `scratch` shows them in the editor as suggestions the player can click to load that recipe. ### What I found (cause not confirmed) Reading the code, every part still looks connected, so the builder needs to reproduce this in the client before changing anything: - Engine: `effects/choose.rs` `choose_craft` puts `subsystems::craft::presets_for` into the prompt's options, and `view_for.rs` `option_view` copies `Selection::Craft { recipe }` into `PendingOption.recipe`. - Client: `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.tsx` around lines 134 and 329 renders the `.craft-suggestions` row (`data-testid="craft-preset-N"`) when `!scratch && presets.length > 0`. Its styles are in `craft.css` around line 240. - Last change to the editor: #4119's audit (87bd2795), which only swapped `sheetQuery` to `queryList`. #3043 (True Craft's points cut to 80%, R3043000) threaded the mode through `craft_presets`. Things to check: whether the presets come back empty or invalid for some cost or offer (`preset_unit` and `preset_effect` can drop a preset the budget can't afford, and `craft_presets` uses `out.extend`), whether the options carry `recipe` across the WASM/wire boundary, and whether the row renders but sits off-screen or hidden, especially in the phone `sheet` layout. ### How to reproduce `/dev/hotseat` or `/practice`: cast True Craft a Card, pick a cost, and look for the Suggestions row in the editor. Repeat with Jazakus's and Jazakus Prime's battlecries. ### Acceptance - In the live client, the editor shows the presets as clickable suggestions for True Craft a Card (every cost 0 to `CRAFT_MAX_COST`, both faces), Jazakus and Jazakus Prime, and clicking one loads its recipe. - Scratch Pad still shows none (R1182002). - A test pins down the root cause where it was (engine, wire or web), named after the ruling it proves (R881 or R1563007). If the fix needs a decision the spec doesn't make, it gets a new ruling under this issue's block. ## Plan _Written by `claude-6` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44694266525)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal The bug did not reproduce on base `ae977ece3e`. The suggestions render, and clicking one loads its recipe, in every case I tried: - True Craft a Card at costs 0–4 on both faces. - Jazakus (`potion`) and Jazakus Prime (`hugePotion`). - Scratch Pad shows none, as R1182002 requires. I checked in three places: the dev client, the built e2e client, and a jsdom probe that drove the real WASM engine. In the browser I tried 8 viewport sizes from 320×568 to 1366×768, phone sheet included. What a player does meet is a row with no visible name. It is one to three bare buttons under the card face, and the first one repeats the card's own name, so it reads as a caption. "Suggestions" exists only as an `aria-label`, so the issue's "look for the Suggestions row" finds nothing on screen. True Craft usually shows only 2 presets. That is by design: R1563007 offers two hats, so the Spell and Trap presets often drop ("a prompt has one to four"). Done means: - The row carries a visible "Suggestions" heading, styled like the palette's section headings. - One test drives every listed card's live prompt through the real engine: `viewFor` → `Prompt` → `CraftEditor`. It proves each preset is a suggestion that loads and sends its recipe, and that Scratch Pad shows none. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes there | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.tsx` | change | The suggestions row (lines 329–343): a `
` with an `

` heading over a `.craft-row` of the same buttons | | `apps/web/src/game/craft/craft.css` | change | `.craft-suggestions h3` joins the `.craft-palette section h3` rule (line 83); the `.craft-suggestions { display: flex … }` rule (lines 240–244) is deleted | | `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx` | change | New `describe` block: the real-engine chain test (R1563007) and Scratch Pad's (R1182002) | **Must not touch:** - Rust code anywhere: the engine, the cards, the WASM crate, the wire types. - `apps/web/src/game/Prompt.tsx`. - Any spec note, and the i18n catalogs: the key `"Suggestions"` already exists, `zh-CN.json:631`. - Anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `bot/`. No ruling, `spec/pending` paragraph or patch fragment is needed. The change ships no card data and changes no card's look (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`). Governing: R880, R881, R1563007 (one to four presets, built from the offer), R1182002 (Scratch Pad shows no suggestion), CLAUDE.md rule 7. ## Steps 1. **`CraftEditor.tsx`.** Replace the block that starts `{!scratch && presets.length > 0 && (` and ends at the matching `)}` after `` (lines 329–343) with the block below. The ` ), )}

)} ``` The gate changes from `presets.length > 0` to `.some(recipe)`. Without that, a visible heading would sit over an empty row. 2. **`craft.css`.** - Change the selector `.craft-palette section h3 {` to `.craft-palette section h3,\n.craft-suggestions h3 {`. - Delete the whole `.craft-suggestions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-3); }` rule. `.craft-row` now wraps the buttons with the same gap. - Keep `.craft-suggestions button` and the sheet rule `.craft-editor[data-layout="sheet"] .craft-suggestions button`, which still match. 3. **`CraftEditor.test.tsx`: imports.** - Widen the type import to `import type { Action, ActionBody, PlayerId, PlayerView } from "@jackioh/shared";`. - Add `import { SANDBOX_MANA_MAX } from "@jackioh/engine/config";`. - Add `import { devDeck, realPort } from "../../audio/test/realGame.ts";`. - Add `import Prompt from "../Prompt.tsx";`. 4. **`CraftEditor.test.tsx`: constants and the sandbox helper.** Add these above a new `describe`: - `const TRUE_CRAFT = "meditative-017"; // True Craft a Card` - `JAZAKUS = "meditativeplus-016"`, `JAZAKUS_PRIME = "meditativeplus-016-1"`, `SCRATCH_PAD = "meditativeplus-026"` - `SETUP_STEPS_MAX = 40` - `const port = realPort();` Then write `function castInSandbox(defId: string, radiant: boolean)`. It returns `{ view(): PlayerView; answers(): ActionBody[]; act(body: ActionBody): void }`, all for `"p1"`. Copy `heroicGame()` in `apps/web/src/game/heroicPower.real.test.ts` (lines 61–98): 1. `port.beginGame(port.createGame({ seed: "r1563007-live-craft", decks: [cheap, cheap], sandbox: true } as Parameters[0])).state`, with `cheap = devDeck("cheap20")`. 2. Its `raw` reducer, with nonces `r1563007-N`. 3. Its setup loop, up to `SETUP_STEPS_MAX` steps, until p1's main phase with no pending prompt. 4. Sandbox `setMana` for p1, `current` and `max` both `SANDBOX_MANA_MAX`. 5. Sandbox `spawn`: `{ kind: "spawn", player: "p1", defId, ...(radiant ? { radiant: true } : {}), to: { zone: "hand" } }`. 6. Find the spawned card in p1's hand by `defId` and take its legal `play`, the one with `faceDown === undefined`. Throw if there is none, then `raw("p1", play)`. `answers()` is `port.legalActions(state, "p1").filter((a) => a.type === "answer")`. 5. **`CraftEditor.test.tsx`: helpers.** - `function answerCost(game, cost: number): void`. It finds the answer whose `JSON.stringify(a.selection) === JSON.stringify([{ pick: "mode", option: String(cost) }])`, throws if there is none, and acts it. - `function expectSuggestions(view: PlayerView, where: string): void`: 1. Throw unless `view.pending` is `forYou` with `kind === "craft"`. 2. Expect `options.length > 0`. 3. `render()` with `onAction = vi.fn()`. 4. `const row = screen.getByLabelText("Suggestions")`, and expect `within(row).getByRole("heading", { name: "Suggestions" })`. 5. For each `option, index`, with `where` in each message: - expect `option.recipe` to be defined; - click `within(row).getByTestId(`craft-preset-${String(index)}`)`, then `screen.getByTestId("prompt-submit")`; - expect `onAction` `toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ type: "answer", choiceId: pending.choiceId, selection: [{ pick: "craft", recipe: option.recipe }] })`. 6. Finish with `cleanup()`. 6. **`CraftEditor.test.tsx`: the tests.** Add `describe("R1563007 the live prompt's presets are its suggestions (#4294)", …)` holding two tests. - `it("R1563007 every cost and face of True Craft a Card, Jazakus and Jazakus Prime: viewFor's presets are suggestions that load and send their recipe", …)`: 1. `const costs = castInSandbox(TRUE_CRAFT, false).answers().length`, and expect it to be at least 1. 2. For `radiant` in `[false, true]` and each `cost` from 0 to `costs - 1`: cast in a fresh game, `answerCost`, expect `view().pending.budget === cost`, then `expectSuggestions(view, `True Craft cost ${cost} radiant ${radiant}`)`. 3. Then `expectSuggestions(castInSandbox(JAZAKUS, false).view(), "Jazakus")`, and the same for `JAZAKUS_PRIME`. Their Cry opens the prompt directly. 4. Also assert `craftMode` is `"potion"` for Jazakus and `"hugePotion"` for Prime. - `it("R1182002 Scratch Pad's live prompt keeps its presets for the AI and shows no suggestion", …)`: 1. Cast `SCRATCH_PAD`, `answerCost(game, 2)`. 2. Expect `pending.craftMode === "scratch"` and `pending.options.length > 0`. 3. Render `Prompt`, then expect `screen.queryByLabelText("Suggestions")` to be null and `screen.queryAllByTestId(/^craft-preset-/)` to have length 0. Use no non-null assertions (`!`) or array indexing that eslint or `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` would flag. 7. **Look at it once in the live client** (ui-walkthrough skill). This is verification only; commit no screenshot. 1. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web dev --port 5173 --strictPort` in the background. 2. `sh scripts/browse.sh open "http://localhost:5173/dev/hotseat?seed=15"`. 3. Through `eval`, set `localStorage["jackioh.e2e.decks"]` to `{"decks":{"craft":[ "meditative-017","meditativeplus-016","meditativeplus-026", "core-001" … "core-022" ]}}`. A deck is exactly 25 distinct, non-token cards. 4. `goto "/dev/hotseat?seed=15&a=craft&b=craft"`. Seed 15 deals True Craft to p1. 5. Through `window.__jackioh`: keep both hands, play True Craft, answer the cost-2 `mode` answer. 6. Wait for `.craft-editor`, then `screenshot ".craft-side"`. 7. Repeat with `open "--device=iPhone 13" …`. The heading must sit above the buttons in both. Stop the server and run `browse.sh close` afterwards. ## Tests - `apps/web/src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx`, the two `it`s above. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/craft/CraftEditor.test.tsx`; its pretest builds the WASM. - Without step 1, the heading assertion fails. - The rest pins the whole chain: engine presets → `option_view`'s `recipe` → wire → `Prompt` → `CraftEditor` → the sent answer. That chain had no test that crosses it: every web craft test feeds a hand-written fixture. - My scratch probe of this flow (deleted) saw 2 presets for every True Craft case, 3 for Jazakus, 3 for Prime, and 0 buttons over 4 engine options for Scratch Pad. Assert counts as `> 0`, never as exact numbers: they follow the rng. - Regressions in the same file and in `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Prompt.test.tsx`: - the existing `R880 a suggestion loads…` test; - the `R1182002 … no suggestion` tests, which call `queryByLabelText("Suggestions")`; - `R1182000 R1563008 pins a Spell…` (`craft-preset-0`). - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`, which CI runs. ## Done when - [ ] The suggestions row has a visible "Suggestions" heading. Its buttons load and send their recipe for True Craft (every cost, both faces), Jazakus and Jazakus Prime; Scratch Pad shows none. - [ ] Both new tests pass, and the heading assertion fails without step 1. No existing test is changed or weakened. - [ ] The touched web test files pass, along with typecheck, eslint and the harness's checks. `cargo jackioh spec check` passes: R1563007 and R1182002 already list `CraftEditor.test.tsx`. - [ ] Step 7's two screenshots were looked at. - [ ] The report says the reported symptom did not reproduce on base, and names the decisions below. ## Risks - **Hidden information (R97, rule 7):** the test reads only p1's `viewFor`. Never render from `port`'s raw state. - **Determinism:** nothing in the engine changes, so no replay, golden or fuzz effect. The test's preset counts follow the rng: assert `> 0`, never exact counts. - **Layout:** the sheet's 44px targets and the `PHONE_SHEET_QUERY` gate are untouched. The `.craft-side` grid and flex rules still place the section as one item. - **AI and timeouts:** Scratch Pad's engine presets stay, so do not filter options in the engine. The client gate stays `!scratch`. ## Open questions The reported bug did not reproduce on base `ae977ece3e` anywhere I looked: the dev and built clients at 8 viewport sizes, and the real WASM in jsdom. `_production` (2026-11-10) differs from base in the editor only by #4119's `queryList` swap. So this plan treats the missing visible name as what the reporter met. If @MaxGoetzmann saw the row truly absent somewhere, they should name the route, card, cost and screen size, and that case gets a test of its own. **Decisions, with the alternatives rejected:** - **No engine or wire change.** Both are proven working. - **Preset count left as it is.** Showing 1–2 presets is what R1563007 rules ("one to four"). Always offering four would reverse that ruling. - **No Rust holder-view test.** The real-WASM chain test covers the same `option_view` path. - **No type tag on the buttons, and `aria-labelledby` not used.** A heading is the smallest change that names the row, and the palette already uses `aria-label` with an `h3`. ````
